sources.title: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo - LA Studio
sources.snippet: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo is a 48 kHz Vietnamese-English text-to-speech model from Pham Nguyen Ngoc Bao. LA Studio uses the native VieNeu-TTS.cpp runtime packages with the vieneu-v3-native pipeline for local synthesis and runtime-reported inference progress.

sources.title: VieNeu-TTS-v3-Turbo by pnnbao-ump, Text To Speech | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, VieNeu-TTS-v3-Turbo runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of text to speech data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
